ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Find the length of $AB$ in the isosceles triangle $ABC$.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is triangle ABC, A is at the upper left, B is at the upper right, and C is below; the top side AB is labeled 9x - 1, the left slanted side AC is labeled 4x + 1, and the right slanted side BC is labeled 5x - 0.5. AC and BC have the same pink tick marks on them, indicating that these two sides are congruent. Then reason: Because AC = BC, so 4x + 1 = 5x - 0.5. Solving gives 1.5 = x, that is, x = 1.5. Substitute x = 1.5 into AB = 9x - 1, obtaining AB = 9(1.5) - 1 = 13.5 - 1 = 12.5.
